purpose: Separate bounded one-case pilot proof closure from general Hyperposition training-proof closure after moving-main convergence. This prevents already source-bound pilot subjects from being incorrectly marked wholly unbound while also preventing source-level progress from being inflated into positive training admission.

closure_matrix.reason: Generator path, source digest, source commit, schema, deterministic parameters and materials are pinned by repository authority; generation gate resolves these from authority rather than accepting row path as authority.

Generation-provenance gate deterministically rebuilds formal_world, dependence registry, current event and state_before and compares admitted JCS hashes/object equality. For this one authority-pinned case, coherent caller substitution of those subjects is source-rejected in the candidate code path.

The current pilot event is reconstructed as SYNTHETIC_PROOF by the pinned generator and the epistemic guard permits it. This does not establish a general rule that any caller string SYNTHETIC_PROOF is evidence authority.

The trusted generator bundle contains clean genesis plus empty history, but generation-provenance gate v1 authenticates state_before rather than genesis/history as independent reconstructed subjects. The one empty-history case therefore has less attack surface, but no nonempty-history positive family is promotable until genesis/history commitment is authority-bound.

For the one case, authority pins world_id and exact formal-world/event subject hashes. The retained event_semantic_sha256 itself omits world identity, so cross-world global replay identity remains too weak for general training proof.

Current state-history code validates typed receipt shape, event/world binding, u_test_order coverage, admissible=true, executed=true and a nonempty execution_receipt_id, but those execution/admission assertions remain row-carried. Current source tests themselves synthesize those values, proving shape/coverage logic rather than trusted execution provenance.

Typed OBSERVED receipt structure exists, but source/provenance/time strings are not yet independently source-content/qualification-rule authenticated. This does not block the present SYNTHETIC_PROOF case specifically, but it blocks future OBSERVED positive supervision.

Focused Trigger-2 source tests exist, but no admitted exact-current repository-bound execution receipt for the generation->epistemic->replay v3 chain has been observed. Portable GO acceptance runner targets unrelated S0/fabric components and therefore cannot supply this credit.
Rendered semantic-ablation/nuisance decoder, full-cross or conditional-MI, family/provenance split and tokenizer/ABI gates remain downstream requirements even after proof-source closure.
Measured Josiefied gabliterated snapshot is a TARGET_MEASURED_UNSELECTED candidate; no matched immutable loader-bound winner selection has occurred.
